name: Night Light (sunsetr)
author: Sam Kiessler
description: Night light indicator and toggle backed by sunsetr instead of hyprsunset. Replaces the built-in NightLight bar icon; the stock omarchy.nightlight service is left dormant.

barWidget.description: Bar icon showing sunsetr's night light state. Left = toggle, right = status popup, middle = refresh.

schema.label: sunsetr preset used to force day
sunsetr preset used to force night
While off: hover (peek with centre section, like stock), always, or never
